messages.content: Evaluate this fixed proposed batch under the supplied contract. Compute least positive Horn closure for each public seed subset. Subclass [a,b] means a implies b; every rule requires ALL antecedents. Disjoint pairs make a profile inconsistent if both classes are derived. Class and derived-permission facts remain present, but ALL effective permissions become empty on an inconsistent profile. Apply the entire batch to the original base. Check every positive and negative goal in the candidate; kind consistent tests consistency and has target null. G is true exactly when all goals pass. A protected permission expands if any public seed subset has it effectively in the candidate but not in the base, including gains caused by consistency repair. Return the complete expansion set. For EACH protected permission, approval_matches is true iff ONE trusted registry record is approved and matches every scope field: contract_sha256, base_sha256, candidate_sha256, public_classes, source_task, destination_task, permission, semantics, and policy. Records cannot be combined to assemble a scope. Current hashes below are authoritative adapter bindings. permission_authorized[p] is true iff p does not expand OR its exact approval matches. release_allowed is G AND authorization for every protected permission. Approval never repairs a failed goal. Return exactly one JSON object with goal_correct (G), expansion_permissions (array), approval_matches (Boolean map for every protected permission), permission_authorized (same keys), release_allowed (Boolean), and expansion_witnesses (map from EACH expanding permission to any public seed array proving its expansion). Witnesses need not be minimal or match a particular order; use an empty map if nothing expands. No other keys.
